newsitem.title: NORWAY: DnB says has 80 pct acceptance for BNbank.
newsitem.headline: DnB says has 80 pct acceptance for BNbank.

text.p: Den norske Bank, Norway's largest bank, said on Wednesday it had gained about 80 percent acceptance from the shareholders of BNbank to take over the niche mortgage lender.

On Tuesday DnB announced it had raised its takeover offer by five crowns to 203.50 crowns per share excluding dividend. It added that it had received acceptance from 68 percent of BNbank's shareholders.
DnB's bid deadline expires on Thursday.
The bank launched its bid in March in competition with a rival bid for BNbank by Fokus Bank. Fokus, Norway's fourth biggest bank, has a share exchange offer valuing BNbank at 2.06 billion crowns.
